findings.evidence: A grep shows the identical `have hN … rw [I.range_eq_univ, nhdsWithin_univ] at hN` pair at Germ.lean:57-58, 62-63, 99-100, 118-119 and 138-139. Mathlib only provides the `𝓝[range I]` form (ExtChartAt.lean:360).
findings.fix: Add `ModelWithCorners.extendCoordChange_source_mem_nhds [I.Boundaryless] (hx : x ∈ e.source) (hx' : x ∈ e'.source) : (I.extendCoordChange e e').source ∈ 𝓝 (I (e x))` to `ExtChartAt.lean` next to `extendCoordChange_apply`, and use it at all five sites.
findings.issue: The same three steps, `have hN := I.extendCoordChange_source_mem_nhdsWithin' …; rw [I.range_eq_univ, nhdsWithin_univ] at hN; filter_upwards [hN]`, appear five times: lines 57, 62, 99, 118 and 138. findings.evidence: Germ.lean:120-122 and Germ.lean:140-142 are textually identical.
findings.fix: State a lemma such as `extendCoordChange e' e'' ∘ extendCoordChange e e' =ᶠ[𝓝 (I (e x))] extendCoordChange e e''`, plus the analogous `(f ∘ (e'.extend I).symm) ∘ extendCoordChange e e' =ᶠ[𝓝 _] f ∘ (e.extend I).symm`, and derive both theorems from them.
findings.issue: `analyticGermsEquiv_trans` (lines 118-122) and `analyticGermsEquiv_of_contMDiffAt` (lines 138-142) end with the same five lines: `filter_upwards …; simp only [comp_apply, extendCoordChange, PartialEquiv.coe_trans]; rw [(e'.extend I).left_inv (x := (e.extend I).symm y) hy.2]`. Both prove the same fact, that composing transition maps (or a chart representative with a transition map) agrees near the point, and both get there by unfolding the `extendCoordChange` definition.

findings.evidence: The `simpa only [OpenPartialHomeomorph.extend_coe, comp_apply]` occurrences are at Germ.lean:50, 52, 75, 131 and 134. The existing lemma `analyticAt_extendCoordChange` (ContMDiff/Analytic.lean:87) is stated at `e.extend I x`.
findings.fix: Add lemma forms stated at `I (e x)`: `analyticAt_extendCoordChange'` (`AnalyticAt 𝕜 (I.extendCoordChange e e') (I (e x))`) and the analogous variant of `analyticAt_comp_extend_symm`. Pass these named terms in the definition and in both statements.
findings.issue: The proof `by simpa only [OpenPartialHomeomorph.extend_coe, comp_apply] using I.analyticAt_extendCoordChange …` is pasted into the definition (lines 50, 52) and again into the statement of `analyticGermsEquiv_apply` (line 75). The same `simpa` on `hf.analyticAt_comp_extend_symm` is pasted into the statement of `analyticGermsEquiv_of_contMDiffAt` (lines 131, 134). Theorem statements that contain `simpa` proofs depend on proof irrelevance to match the definition, and will break if the simp set changes.

summary: The chart-transport proofs in `ContMDiff/Germ.lean` repeat the same neighborhood boilerplate five times, close two theorems with an identical transition-composition argument, and place copies of the same `simpa` proof inside theorem statements. Each should be factored into a reusable lemma.
